name: io.studiomeyer/meetmyagent
title: MeetMyAgent
description: Search the free, AI-native MeetMyAgent marketplace + business directory and list your own offers, from any MCP client. Anonymous discovery needs no account; an optional API key unlocks listing your business, service or product.

environmentVariables.name: MEETMYAGENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. API key from meetmyagent.io/console (scope listings:write). Without it: anonymous marketplace reads. With it: also list your own business/service/product.

environmentVariables.name: MEETMYAGENT_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. API base URL. Default https://meetmyagent.io.
